register.aee_hook_pass: PASSED at the freeze act of 2026-10-21 under aee 1.5.3: the register is carried from Spec 059's recovered freeze register (0.8-draft) with the successor's changes recorded in adjudication.md sections 3-4 and 8 (DD-067-7's gate-bar adoption in F067-C04, DD-067-9's layer-v2 pins in F067-C05, the step-0 type-fill census in F067-C07 and F067-C12, the section 5 re-statement rule in F067-C15); after_specify, after_plan and after_tasks were each clean at first pass over the carried register - at every hook 15 FR-2.3 draft-cap records only, zero correctness failure modes, and no claim below the 0.70 threshold (minimum propagated 0.72); the engine outcome word reads iterate solely from the draft-cap records (gate reading DD-067-14; record in specs/067-f1-enlarged-join/aee/freeze-aee-note.md)

basis.decisions: DECIDED by the owner on 2026-10-21 (not proposals): the amendment package Item 7, approved 2026-10-21, names this successor in its section 6 - a new spec, a new freeze, and a new OSF registration of its own, re-running Spec 059's design on the enlarged joined set produced by the Spec 066 intake, with a mandatory step-0 type-fill census. Draft decisions DD-067-1 to DD-067-6 are recorded in adjudication.md section 4 and are confirmed or completed at the freeze. Freeze decisions DD-067-7 to DD-067-14 are recorded in adjudication.md section 8: the gate bar adopted openly at the freeze - Spec 059's bar carried unchanged, joined share at least 61.0 percent, at least 3,465 of 5,679 joined rows, its basis stated on the record and the projection-fitting route refused (DD-067-7); the single-test correction family confirmed, carrying DD-059-8 (DD-067-8); the sources named and pinned in the DD-059-9 form - the lineage layer's cisi field carried as provenance.object_id under the pinned Phase-130 schema per the pinned Spec 034 route-(b) construction, resolving against the pinned merged catalogue layer v2, itself pinned as a definition constant and asserted on the local file (DD-067-9); the spec's own OSF contract registration filed at the freeze under E-1 (DD-067-10); the gate census and the type-fill census confirmed sufficient as the join's audit (DD-067-11); DD-067-3's verdict precedence confirmed (DD-067-12); Phase-429 allocated (DD-067-13); and the DD-038-10 AEE gate reading adopted as DD-067-14.

design.act: run the step-0 gates of spec section 3 in order - input integrity (the merged catalogue layer v2 asserted on the local file before any join work), original-join reproduction, the object-identifier join census against layer v2, the type-fill census, and the gate comparison against the adopted bar - and, only if the gate passes, apply the frozen Phase-136 flow unchanged to the enlarged joined set, reaching exactly one of the pre-registered outcomes of spec sections 5 and 9

claim_under_test.record: SETTLED - SUPPORTED on its joined subset: Mantel-Haenszel common odds ratio 2.384, 95% CI [1.847, 3.077], permutation raw p 0.0001 (B = 9,999, seed 20261009), family Benjamini-Hochberg q = 0.00015 in the combined Stage 2 report; Phase-141 leave-one-site-out STABLE, every dropped-site interval excluding 1; Spec 059's replication attempt closed at step 0, JOIN GATE NOT MET (Phase-421: 2,899 of 5,679 joined, 51.05 percent, shortfall 566 rows against the same bar), and that record stands exactly as written

design.falsifier: on the enlarged set, the within-site test's interval for the odds ratio includes 1.0, or the point estimate falls below 1.5 - meaning the original result was partly an artefact of which rows could be joined; mapped onto the verdict words by F067-C11 with the precedence of DD-067-3, confirmed at DD-067-12

gate.ruling: DD-067-7 (OF-067-1 resolved): the operative bar is Spec 059's bar carried unchanged, adopted openly at this freeze in the DD-059-7 form - joined share at least 61.0 percent, i.e. at least 3,465 joined rows of 5,679 (0.61 x 5,679 = 3,464.19; 3,464 rows = 60.997 percent and fails). Basis stated on the record in adjudication.md section 8: same design, same lineage layer, same denominator, same original baseline; the strictest of DD-059-7's three readings; no bar is derived from Spec 066's projection
gate.refused_readings: exact-points: 50.977 percent + 10 points = 60.977 percent, threshold 3,462.9 rows, i.e. at least 3,463 rows; relative: a 10 percent relative rise - 56.1 percent on the rounded base (threshold 3,185.92 rows, at least 3,186) or 56.075 percent on the unrounded base (threshold 3,184.5 rows, at least 3,185); both refused at DD-059-7 and refused again at DD-067-7; also refused: any bar derived from Spec 066's projection (4,676 rows, 82.34 percent), which is arithmetic over grades with no standing
gate.closure: below the bar the execution closes at step 0, unscored, as CLOSED AT STEP 0 - JOIN GATE NOT MET, in the pre-written wording of spec section 3.6, with the gate census and the type-fill census published as the finding

join.ruling: DD-067-9 (in the DD-059-9 form): the sources are named and pinned on the record of record; no source is invented and no substitute source is admitted; the merged catalogue layer v2 is pinned as a definition constant and asserted on the local file at gate 0.1, before any join work
join.construction: each lineage row's object identifier is carried as cited provenance data - provenance.object_id - under the Phase-130 intake schema, following Spec 034's route-(b) construction (build_intake_dataset in the pinned Phase-398 builder); a row is joined if and only if its identifier resolves to exactly one distinct object in the merged catalogue layer v2; rows resolving to zero or to more than one are counted as unjoined or ambiguous and enter nothing; the census unit is the layer row (DD-067-2), with the distinct-object count reported descriptively

lineage_source.identifier: each row's published CISI object reference is its cisi field, carried as provenance.object_id

converted_form.posture: the programme-built converted form of the same lineage layer (build record in reports/phase398_results.json: 5,679 source inscriptions, 5,018 carrying a CISI reference) - the same rows and the same cisi values, not a second source

catalogue_source.file: cisi_catalogue_layer_v2.csv (restricted local store, beside the vols. 1-2 catalogue CSVs; never committed)
catalogue_source.posture: the merged catalogue layer built by Spec 066 (Phase-428) - vols. 1-2 (7,705 rows, 3,493 distinct objects) plus 2,036 new VERIFIED CISI 3.1 objects, 53 collisions recorded with the existing object standing; pinned in Spec 066's outcome and asserted on the local file at this freeze (rows and distinct objects counted from the file); the gate-0.2 reproduction instead resolves against the vols. 1-2 layer exactly as frozen in Specs 024/059

join.audit: DD-067-11 (OF-067-4 resolved): the gate census of spec section 3.3 and the type-fill census of spec section 3.4, published either way, suffice as the join's audit; no separate join audit is required before execution

design.type_fill_census: mandatory at step 0 (spec section 3.4, gate 0.4; Item 7 section 6): before any F1 quantity exists, census type fill on the newly joined objects (the intake record's expectation, not a result: 126 of the 1,293 overlap numbers carried blank plate headings, so their objects enter layer v2 with type unfilled; the previously joined set already carried 143 unfilled-type objects, Phase-421 census) and on the whole joined set, and report the resulting eligible seal/tablet strata under the frozen Phase-136 eligibility mapping; a gate-passed join with too few typed seals/tablets in eligible strata closes as NOT ESTIMABLE under the frozen mapping (F067-C12)
design.string_boundary: binding (F067-C06; spec section 7.1): no step of the join, census, or test treats equality of any string - a catalogue number string, a name, the layer's cisi field as a string, or a cisi_number - as evidence that two records concern the same physical object; the ground is Spec 037's census (693 exact-string candidates: 269 VERIFIED, 341 CONFLICT (49.21 percent), 83 UNRESOLVED); the cisi value enters only as cited provenance data in the schema's declared provenance.object_id field and resolves against catalogue object IDs; the original concordance join is re-run at gate 0.2 only to reproduce the recorded baseline and contributes no row to the enlarged set
design.restricted_discipline: binding (spec section 7.3): the merged catalogue layer v2 stays in the restricted local store, hash-pinned only, never committed; row-level products of the merged layer stay restricted-local and are named in the outcome by filename and counts only; committed products are aggregates, the gate and type-fill censuses in aggregate form, and the results record in Spec 059's form
design.machinery: identical to Phase-136, unchanged in every particular (F067-C10): catalogue object_type; restriction to {Seals, Tablets}; sequence parse re.findall(r'\d{3}', text), terminal = last parsed code; frozen Spec 018 section 3 canonical W-to-P mapping over the pinned registry, UNK excluded and counted; TERMINAL14 = {P020, P076, P095, P099, P108, P125, P210, P226, P256, P346, P359, P378, P384, P385}; stratum eligibility N >= 20 and >= 5 Seals and >= 5 Tablets; estimability >= 2 eligible strata and pooled expected counts >= 5 in at least 80 percent of the 4 cells; Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel chi-square, no continuity correction; permutation null within strata, B = 9,999, seed 20261009, p = (1 + #{perm >= obs}) / (1 + B); Mantel-Haenszel common odds ratio with Robins-Breslow-Greenland 95 percent CI
design.correction: DD-067-8, carrying DD-059-8: the confirmatory family under this spec is its single primary test; the Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment at q = 0.05 is over one p-value and the adjusted q equals the raw permutation p; the Spec 024 family (F1/F2/F3) was corrected once in its combined report and is closed; no wider family is declared

verdicts.mapping: REPLICATED: adjusted q below 0.05 and the odds-ratio interval entirely above 1.5; WEAKENED: adjusted q below 0.05, the interval not including 1.0, but reaching below 1.5; NOT REPLICATED: adjusted q at or above 0.05, or the interval including 1.0
verdicts.precedence: DD-067-12, confirming DD-067-3 (which carries DD-059-3/DD-059-12): an interval including 1.0 is NOT REPLICATED even when q is below 0.05; WEAKENED is reserved for intervals excluding 1.0 but reaching below 1.5

design.reporting: every gate-passed outcome reports the Phase-141 leave-one-site-out rerun descriptively (it mints no verdict and changes no verdict word) and both covariate comparisons - joined versus unjoined rows, and the original joined set versus the rows the layer-v2 join adds - on every covariate the data carries (site, object type, text length, preservation as recorded); a covariate the data does not carry is named as not carried, never reconstructed

design.step0_gates: fail-closed, in order, before any enlarged-set quantity (spec section 3): gate 0.1 input integrity - every spec section 2 pin and every DD-067-9 pin hashes to its freeze-record value (the merged layer v2 pin asserted on the local file) and the Phase-130 validation of the join dataset returns pass, or the run stops as INVALID (PIN FAILURE for a pin mismatch; CENSUS FAILURE for a validation failure); gate 0.2 original-join reproduction against the vols. 1-2 layer - the frozen concordance rule reproduces the recorded census exactly (5,679 layer rows; 2,895 matched; 2 ambiguous; 2,782 unmatched), or INVALID - CENSUS FAILURE; gate 0.3 the object-identifier join census against layer v2 by resolution class; gate 0.4 the type-fill census on the newly joined objects and the whole joined set, with the resulting eligible seal/tablet strata; gate 0.5 the gate comparison against the adopted bar (DD-067-7) - below it, CLOSED AT STEP 0 - JOIN GATE NOT MET; nothing is repaired at run time
design.freeze_does_not: this freeze does not itself join anything: no join against layer v2 has been run by this spec, no census computed, no type fill taken, no joined share exists, and the gate is not decided in either direction; Spec 066's projection (4,676 rows, 82.34 percent) is not a census and is treated as one nowhere in this freeze; it edits no Spec 024 or Spec 059 record and moves no anchor
design.execution_gate: Not satisfied at the freeze of 2026-10-21: execution runs as Phase-429 only after this freeze has merged, the OSF contract registration's approval act has completed (the parent's approval click on OSF's admin notification), and a separate execution order is given

anchors.posture: this spec moves no anchor; the file is asserted byte-identical before and after any execution

local_store.posture: the lineage layer, the catalogue volumes, the converted keyed layer, and the merged catalogue layer v2 are held in the local store and are not committed; their freeze pins are carried as the definition constants in design.join in the Spec 038 form, and the committed records that carry the same hashes (the Phase-136 results file for the layer and the catalogue volumes; Spec 066's outcome for layer v2) are asserted in-repo by the freeze tests; gate 0.1 recomputes every local-store pin at execution, the layer v2 pin on the local file before any join work
